criteria_cited: POL-004 — Journal Entry and Manual Adjustment Review Policy | §3 Preparer and Reviewer Requirements | Reviewer must be a different individual from the preparer; verifies business purpose, amounts, accounts, and supporting documentation.
POL-004 — Journal Entry and Manual Adjustment Review Policy | §4 Timeliness | Review must be completed within 2 business days of posting date.
Synthetic Audit Standard — Control Operating-Effectiveness Testing | §S1 | Operating effectiveness: the control operated as designed consistently throughout the period.

Synthetic Audit Standard — Control Operating-Effectiveness Testing | §S4 | Evaluating Results: when no deviations are found, auditor may conclude the control operated effectively, subject to inherent limitations of the test.
